about: Worksheets for scripts/key-benchmark.mjs. Each needs the blank worksheet pages as image or PDF files and the correct key, by question number. Put real secondary-math worksheets here (Algebra 2; Geometry with tables and graphs). The files are the teacher's blank worksheet, never student work.

standards.title: Rewrite rational expressions
standards.domain: Arithmetic with Polynomials and Rational Expressions
standards.wording: Rewrite simple rational expressions in different forms.

standards.title: Add, subtract, multiply, divide rational expressions
standards.domain: Arithmetic with Polynomials and Rational Expressions
standards.wording: Understand that rational expressions form a system analogous to the rational numbers; add, subtract, multiply, and divide rational expressions.

standards.title: Solve rational equations
standards.cluster: Understand solving equations as a process of reasoning
standards.wording: Solve simple rational and radical equations in one variable, and give examples showing how extraneous solutions may arise.
